messages:
maya: quick flag  partner proxy calls are being billed to the proxy org, while console shows partner project. mismatch is creating accounting noise. anyone seen this before?
owen: yep, the exchange path strips original origin claims when minting ephemeral tokens. routing only sees proxy as the caller.
lee: so downstream services don't get org/project in JWT? that's the root cause for quota/billing.
maya: right. exchange returns proxy-scoped tokens without origin metadata.
sam: short-term idea: proxy injects `x-inferred-origin` header for observability only. not trusted for billing but useful for triage.
kevin: for billing/enforcement we need authenticated provenance. two safe choices: (1) signed-origin claim included in token by partner and verified by us, or (2) exchange-id mapping: exchange service records exchange_id->origin at mint and routing does a cache lookup.
own: mapping is lower friction for partners. requires a tiny, low-latency cache in routing to consult exchange_id on every request.
lee: caveat: quota enforcement needs the correct project during the request. mapping cache misses would force fallback behavior. we should support "enforce-on-proxy" while tracking a "would-have" metric.
maya: rollout proposal: telemetry-only for 14d with 1% sampling; enable console reconciliation view and inferred-origin column; canary mapping for one partner (P-77) in us-west-2 with 10% sampling for 72h; pilot signed-origin with volunteer partners later.
sam: canary thresholds: reconciliation delta >3% or cache miss >2% sustained 15m -> rollback. also rollback if p95 request latency increases by >50ms.
kevin: I'll add metrics: `auth.exchange.lookup_requests`, `auth.exchange.lookup_hits`, `auth.exchange.lookup_misses`, `auth.exchange.lookup_latency_ms`, and `auth.reconciliation.delta_pct`. will build a Grafana board and alert rules.
own: implementation notes: feature flag `auth.exchange.origin_map=false` default; mem-LRU cache TTL=5m + redis fallback; circuit-breaker if backend fails. will benchmark p50/p99 lookup.
lee: console UX: add toggle "Show inferred origin (exchange-id)" in Usage + tooltip "May be provisional during rollout" and a reconciliation card showing token-level delta.
maya: security: write mapping logs to secure audit stream, only expose ids (no PII).
auth-bot: deploy initiated: svc-auth-exchange v3.2.0 -> canary us-west-2 (1/4).
maya: action items: owen prototype cache + flag, kevin telemetry/dash, sam finalize canary playbook, lee mock console, maya draft rollout note to partners. thanks all.
